newsitem.title: USA: USDA to donate rice, vegoil to Equatorial Guinea.
newsitem.headline: USDA to donate rice, vegoil to Equatorial Guinea.

text.p: USDA said Tuesday it will donate approximately 198 tonnes of rice and vegetable oil to the International Partnership for Human Development, a private voluntary group, for distribution and sale in Equatorial Guinea.
USDA said 98 tonnes of vegetable oil will be sold to buyers in Equatorial Guinea and the proceeds used to support two aid programs.
The remaining 20 tonnes of vegetable oil and 80 tonnes of rice will be distributed to clinics, dispensaries and hospitals throughout Equatorial Guinea, USDA said.
